'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the chest, the chatbox message "The chest is locked!  An inscription on the chest reads: Stand by your man." is displayed, hinting that you must kill one of the nearby [[men]] for the key.
